unclassified.description: Diagnostic only. Model IDs the provider returned that matched no family rule, and which therefore appear in no family above. Present only when non-empty. Consumers should ignore this field.

recommended_alias.description: Undated alias verified (via the provider's model-retrieve endpoint) to resolve to `recommended`. Prefer it when pinning. Present only when `recommended` is a dated ID with such an alias.

deprecated.description: Always false today: no provider's models endpoint reports deprecation. Retired models stop being listed instead.

max_input_tokens.description: Context window as reported by the provider (Anthropic only). null when the API returned no value.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per request as reported by the provider (Anthropic only). null when the API returned no value.

capabilities.description: Raw Anthropic Models API capability tree, passed through unmodified; leaves are {"supported": boolean}. Anthropic only.

aliases.description: Undated aliases verified to resolve to this dated ID (Anthropic only). An empty array means the undated name was checked and is another model or does not exist; absent means unknown (not checked, or the check failed).
